verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents an `ai_query` parameter for describing the information to extract in natural language (docs-9). It also documents `ai_query`/`ai_extract_rules` for semantic extraction as an alternative to CSS/XPath `extract_rules`, recommended when fields are semantic or structure is irregular (docs-19, docs-20). Missing for 10: detail on the structured output schema or format of `ai_extract_rules`, accuracy or limitation documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration that AI extraction works well.
